dataset.name: GameFlare Verified Games Catalog
dataset.research_scope: Complete expanded packaging of the prior nine-candidate iframe audit plus an official GameFlare popular-games discovery batch from pages 1-10. Discovery is not equivalent to iframe verification.
dataset.candidate_population_definition: Three observed audit failures, six prior not-testable candidates, and newly discovered official-listing candidates from the first ten GameFlare popular-games pages.
dataset.strict_exposure_rule: Only entries in games with iframe_compatibility.status equal to verified_working may be exposed by default.

global_embedding_policy.technical_embedding_status: No candidate completed the strict third-party iframe verification sequence. Discovery candidates have no verified embed URL and may not be publicly exposed by default.
global_embedding_policy.external_ads_around_iframe_status: unclear; do not show external advertising around GameFlare embeds unless written permission is obtained.
restrictions: Use a GameFlare embed URL only after its exact endpoint is separately verified.
Do not derive an unverified embed URL by transforming a canonical game-page URL.
Do not copy, mirror, proxy, self-host, inject into, or modify GameFlare games or their assets.
Do not add layers or advertisements over the iframe or cover GameFlare controls.
Keep a GameFlare-provided bottom bar visible when rendered by the embed.
Do not treat official-listing discovery or technical embedding as commercial-use permission.

exact_url_preservation.notes: Prior audited URLs were retained. New canonical and thumbnail URLs were copied from official GameFlare popular-games card DOM output; unverified embed URLs are null rather than reconstructed.

limitations: No entry passed the prior full strict sequence of iframe load, normal start, and meaningful in-frame gameplay interaction.
The expanded discovery batch is official-listing metadata only; it is not technical or commercial verification.
Newly discovered candidates deliberately have null embed_url values. A pattern-derived endpoint would not be evidence of iframe compatibility.
The child frames in the prior audit were cross-origin, so direct child DOM, console, and detailed network inspection was unavailable from the parent test harness.
Commercial use and external advertising rights remain unverified for all records.

integration_readiness.reason: The strict verified games array remains empty. The expanded candidate pool is traceability data, not a public playable catalog.
